mapper.select: SELECT job_id, job_title, min_salary, max_salary FROM jobs WHERE job_id = #{jobId}
SELECT job_id, job_title, min_salary, max_salary FROM jobs ORDER BY job_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO jobs ( job_id, job_title, min_salary, max_salary ) VALUES ( #{jobId}, #{jobTitle}, #{minSalary}, #{maxSalary} )

MERGE INTO jobs target USING (SELECT #{jobId} AS job_id FROM DUAL) src ON (target.job_id = src.job_id) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.job_title = #{jobTitle}, target.min_salary = #{minSalary}, target.max_salary = #{maxSalary} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( job_id, job_title, min_salary, max_salary ) VALUES ( #{jobId}, #{jobTitle}, #{minSalary}, #{maxSalary} )
